remarks: Come see this spacious 1 Bedroom End Unit. Freshly painted. New Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) flooring throughout. Freshly painted Kitchen Cabinets. New Dining Area Ceiling Light. New Bathroom Vanity & Medicine Cabinet. Quiet space located away from the road & elevator. Comes with 1 assigned indoor garage space #21. Lots of windows for natural light and ample closet space for storage. Rent includes heat, hot water and cooking gas. Large Living Room includes Dining Area. Galley Kitchen has window, gas range and space for additional storage or eat-in area. Clean, bright Laundry Room located in Basement.  Convenient to Downtown Stamford conveniences, I95, Public Transportation and Metro North. No Pets Please. Strong Financials Required. 700 + FICO Score a must.
